notes.title: Update notes for 9.0.2.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New event control feature to trigger events by keyboard shortcuts to support Touch Portal, Stream Desk or other external control software
[*] Improved Linux support (Proton)
[*] Small bug fixes
[/list]
